# PUBLISSO Journals

> PUBLISSO is ZB MED's open-access publishing platform for life sciences research, offering journal hosting, research data management guidance, and digital preservation infrastructure.

PUBLISSO (ZB MED - Informationszentrum Lebenswissenschaften) provides comprehensive support for open-access publishing, research data management, and long-term digital archiving in the life sciences. The platform combines journal hosting services with expert guidance on open science practices and FAIR data principles.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Publishing
- Research Data Management
- FAIR Principles
- Digital Preservation
- DOI / Digital Object Identifiers
- Electronic Lab Notebooks
- Data Management Planning
- Long-term Archiving
- Open Science
- Medical Journals
- Research Data Repositories
- Creative Commons Licensing
- Data Discoverability
- Life Sciences
- Publishing Guidance

## Journal Directory & Publishing

- [Journals Overview](https://journals.publisso.de/en/journals/overview): Directory of open-access medical journals including GMS publications
- [Zeitschriften / Artikel Übersicht](https://journals.publisso.de/de/journals/overview): German-language directory of open-access medical journals and articles
- [Online Open Access Publishing](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/publishing): PUBLISSO open-access publishing platform for life sciences research

## Research Data Management

- [Research Data Management Guide](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/rdm): Research data management guide covering FAIR principles and lifecycle
- [Planning Research Data Management](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/rdm/planning): Guide to data management planning using RDMO for research projects
- [Documenting Research Data: Electronic Lab Notebooks](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/rdm/documenting): Guide to selecting and implementing electronic laboratory notebooks
- [Making Research Data Referenceable and Discoverable](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/rdm/making_rd_referenceable_and_discoverable): Guide to persistent identifiers, DOI registration, and data discoverability
- [Publishing Research Data](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/rdm/publishing): Guide to publishing research data with metadata and DOI assignment
- [Archiving Research Data](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/rdm/archiving): Guide to long-term data archiving and digital preservation standards

## Publishing Support & Advice

- [Publishing Advice](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/advice): Publishing advice service for digital publishing and open-access guidance
- [Publishing Guides](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/advice/guides): Guides on open science, ELN selection, and research data management
- [Publishing FAQs](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/advice/faq): FAQs on academic publishing, open access, and Creative Commons licensing
- [Workshops](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/advice/workshops): Training workshops for researchers and librarians on publication advisory
- [Online Seminars](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/advice/webinars): Webinars on open access, open science, and research data management
- [Personal Consultations](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/advice/personal_consultations): One-on-one consulting for digital publishing and open-access issues

## Infrastructure & Technical Services

- [PUBLISSO System](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/publishing/publisso_system): Open-source Drupal-based publishing system with hosting and maintenance
- [Research Data Repositories](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/publishing/repositories): Life sciences repositories for research data archiving and long-term preservation
- [Digital Preservation](https://journals.publisso.de/en/publisso_gold/digital_preservation): Digital preservation policies and long-term archiving infrastructure
